title: avoid cascading dropdowns
name: Avoid cascading dropdowns
rule: Avoid cascading/interdependent dropdowns (options that appear/disappear from another widget).
pass_when: Choice sets are not chained so that a second dropdown’s options appear/disappear from the first.
fail_when: Interdependent dropdowns where the next list is populated only by the previous widget.
overview: Avoid cascading dropdowns whose options appear or disappear from another widget.
apply_when: Designing dependent choice sets that might chain one dropdown from another.
not_when: Not for independent filters that do not populate each other’s option lists.
agent_hint: Do not chain dropdowns so the next list is populated only by the previous widget.
description: Avoid cascading or interdependent dropdowns where options appear or disappear from another widget. Chained lists force people to re-open and re-scan as each prior choice rewrites the next. Choice sets should not be populated only by a previous dropdown. Fail when interdependent dropdowns populate the next list only from the previous widget. Prefer independent choices or other patterns that do not cascade option lists.
do_not_claim: GOV.UK conditional reveal of a related question (different pattern).
